name: Left Piece Hanging
desc: Your move leaves your own piece en prise to a simple capture, unforced (net material loss, not a trade).

name: Abandoning Defensive Duty
desc: You move a piece away from a critical defensive role, exposing other material or your king to immediate tactics.

name: Greedy Capture
desc: You grab material that is poisoned/trapped/refuted — the capturing piece is lost or a stronger move existed (net negative, NOT an even trade).

name: Premature Trade
desc: An even exchange at the wrong moment — trading off your best piece, simplifying into a worse endgame, or releasing critical tension.

name: Unsound Aggression
desc: A speculative sacrifice or premature attack that is immediately refuted, losing material for insufficient compensation.

name: Pointless Check
desc: A futile or impulsive check that achieves nothing — wastes tempo or hangs the checking piece.

name: King Safety Error
desc: A move that fatally weakens your own king's shelter, walks the king into danger, or ignores a mating threat against you.

name: Missed Hanging Piece
desc: An enemy piece was free to capture (undefended/en prise) with no complications; you played a passive or unrelated move instead.

name: Missed Tactic
desc: A fork, pin, skewer, double attack, zwischenzug, or winning combination was available; you chose a quiet/routine move (non-mating, non-simple-capture).

name: Missed Check or Mate
desc: A forcing check, back-rank mate, or short forced mate was available; you played something quieter or greedier.

name: Passive Play
desc: Drifting with aimless/slow moves when the position demanded concrete action — no specific tactic missed, just a lack of urgency.

name: Endgame Technique
desc: Endgame-specific technique error: wrong king path, premature pawn push, missed opposition/promotion, passive king, rook-placement mistake.
